Title: Broaden the wiki-intent detector so citation-only prompts still preload the relevant MemorySmith context.
Description: A second live probe showed that the prompt 'Cite the source file for the chat tool catalog using a markdown file link' did not count as strong MemorySmith/wiki evidence intent, so the context planner skipped preload entirely. Broaden the detector so citation-only prompts still get the right memory/page preload before the agent starts thinking. Acceptance criteria: citation-only and source-link requests preload the relevant wiki context, the trace records the preload decision, and the behavior remains read-only. Validation: repeat the citation-only chat probe and confirm the preload is populated.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: the 2026-05-24 citation-only probe produced a trace with 'No strong MemorySmith/wiki evidence intent was detected' and zero preload resources, even though the request was clearly about a MemorySmith source link.
